novel_features.name: Subscriber Sources
novel_features.description: See exactly where new subscribers come from: UTM, channel, and referring site, grouped in one call.
novel_features.rationale: Requires grouping every synced subscription row locally; the API serves raw pages, not attribution rollups.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when a growth question needs source attribution without paging the full subscriber list through the API.
novel_features.group: Growth answers from the local store

novel_features.name: Post Performance
novel_features.description: Review recent sends with status, timing, and expanded stats in one compact table.
novel_features.rationale: Joins the synced posts table, including aggregate-stats fields, instead of calling per-post endpoints.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this after a send to review performance without burning per-post API calls.
novel_features.group: Growth answers from the local store

novel_features.name: Referral Health
novel_features.description: Check referral-program config and how many subscribers actually carry referral codes.
novel_features.rationale: Joins publication referral settings with subscriber code coverage; no single API call serves both.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when tuning referral loops to see configuration versus real coverage.
novel_features.group: Growth answers from the local store

novel_features.name: Subscriber Lookup
novel_features.description: Find one subscriber by email or subscription ID and get a compact record instantly.
novel_features.rationale: Resolves from the local store offline; no API round trip and no rate-limit cost.
novel_features.example: beehiiv-pp-cli insights subscriber-lookup pub_477b0b68-0ab1-4b3f-954e-d1f6302b58a7 reader@example.com --agent --select subscription.email,subscription.status
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this for support questions about a single subscriber when offline speed matters.
novel_features.group: Growth answers from the local store

novel_features.name: Churn Sources
novel_features.description: See which sources, channels, and campaigns drive unsubscribes.
novel_features.rationale: Filters synced subscriptions to unsubscribed and groups by acquisition fields locally; the API has no churn-attribution endpoint.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when unsubscribes spike and you need the offending channel fast.
novel_features.group: Growth answers from the local store

novel_features.name: Send-Times
novel_features.description: Find your best send slot: open rate by weekday and hour from your own history.
novel_features.rationale: Buckets synced post send timestamps and joins aggregate stats; no API endpoint serves time-slot rollups.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when scheduling the next send and you want evidence over habit.
novel_features.group: Growth answers from the local store

novel_features.name: Compare Publications
novel_features.description: Side-by-side growth and engagement across every synced publication.
novel_features.rationale: Rolls up publications, subscriptions, and posts across publications locally; the API reports per publication only.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when managing several publications and a client report needs one comparison table.
novel_features.group: Growth answers from the local store

narrative.headline: Sync your Beehiiv audience to a local database and answer growth questions offline in one command.
narrative.value_prop: Beehiiv-pp-cli mirrors publications, subscribers, segments, posts, podcasts, and more into SQLite. Insights commands compute source attribution, churn sources, send-time performance, and cross-publication comparisons with zero API calls. The full v2 surface, including 2026-09 additions like podcasts, exports, and complimentary access, ships as typed commands with dry-run and agent output.
narrative.auth_narrative: Create an API key at app.beehiiv.com (Settings > API Keys) and export BEEHIIV_API_KEY. The key is a bearer token scoped to your organization; 180 requests per minute are shared per org.

quickstart.comment: Verify the binary and auth wiring without calling the API
Mirror the growth-critical entities into local SQLite
Full-text search across synced posts offline
One-command health snapshot computed from the local store

troubleshoots.fix: The CLI applies adaptive backoff; wait for the Retry-After window and reduce concurrent jobs
Use cursor pagination; the CLI sync already prefers cursor tokens
Poll beehiiv-pp-cli exports subscription-show <publicationId> <id> until status is completed, then read download_url

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI for offline audience analytics, bulk subscriber operations, scripting, and CI pipelines. Use it when you want agent-ready JSON output with select/compact/quiet modes and a local store that answers growth questions without API calls.
anti_triggers: Do not use this CLI for beehiv documentation search; use the official docs MCP at developers.beehiiv.com/_mcp/server
Do not use this CLI for OAuth app authorization flows; it is an API-key client
Creating a post with confirmed status and no scheduled_at publishes (sends) immediately; use --dry-run first to inspect the request
